This job is for 32-40 hours per week in a two-shift system, with occasional weekend work. 
The worktimes are from 06.00 - 14:00 and 14.00 - 21:00. Over het bedrijf 
At Jumbo's distribution centre in Woerden, teamwork keeps things moving. Every day, colleagues work together to prepare orders and make sure stores across the Netherlands receive the groceries and everyday products their customers need.
